problems.quote: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-130B Preview, an open-weight model.
problems.explanation: The claims name the model Ripple-65B Preview, not Ripple-130B Preview. The script's model name and parameter count contradict the claims.

problems.quote: ReTrace: agent runs become workflows, 24% cheaper per task
problems.explanation: The 24% lower cost per task is a benchmark the authors report, but the card states it as established fact without attribution.

problems.quote: It is the most capable system of its kind ever released.
problems.explanation: The claims contain no comparison supporting a superlative. They only report vendor benchmark results, so this 'most capable' claim is unsupported.

problems.quote: Today, nVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announce a collaboration
problems.explanation: The story was published 2026-11-08, while the edition date is 2026-11-13. 'Today' does not match the dates given.

problems.quote: It will be free for everyone until the end of 2027.
problems.explanation: No claim says anything about Fractile or the Sovereign AI fund making anything free or about any end date. This fact is invented.
